# Scavland Wiki & Tactical Extraction Knowledge Base

> The authoritative survival wiki, weapon database, and tactical guide for Scavland, the post-apocalyptic top-down extraction shooter developed by NoShadow on Steam Early Access.

This file serves as a structured Markdown index optimized for LLMs, AI agents, and generative search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, Google Gemini). It indexes verified game mechanics, extraction protocols, trader pricing formulas, weapon stats, and community-tested survival strategies.

## Quick Facts & Canonical Links
- **Official Site**: https://scavland.wiki
- **Game Title**: Scavland (Steam App ID: 3373500)
- **Developer**: NoShadow
- **Engine**: Unity
- **Release Status**: Steam Early Access (September 4, 2026)
- **Genre**: Top-Down Extraction Shooter / Tactical Survival RPG
